description: A visitor outside a 0.3 targeted delivery rollout (allocation bucket 9000) is not served the default: evaluation continues to the next rule, here an unrestricted targeted delivery rule. A port that returns the default on exclusion, instead of continuing, fails here.

probe.why: Far outside the 0.3 rollout, so only the second rule can serve it.

reasons: rule "rule_td_alloc" excluded by traffic allocation (hash 9000 >= threshold 3000)
